notes: format_war_rival_of is symmetric and functional (catalogue). The medium of a format uses made_of (the nearest catalogued relation; there is no storage-medium relation in RELATIONS.md). Abandonment by the main backer in 2008 is a class. The stored 'HD DVD fought Blu-ray' gives way after the edit (functional + symmetric would otherwise force Blu-ray = VHS). 'The Video Home System' is a placeholder equal to VHS. The launch decade (q2) is fol (temporal arithmetic): the decade is the launch year minus its remainder by 10; the record labels it dl.

bridge_refs.hddvd_disc: HD DVD is an optical disc format.
bridge_refs.hddvd_abandoned: Toshiba abandoned the HD DVD format in 2008.
bridge_refs.vhs_name: VHS stands for Video Home System.

queries.not_checked: fol (temporal): launch decade of the rival; Z3 checks it from the fol section

fol.notes: The rival is the model's belief (a function with the original and the edit as its values); launch years are stored facts. The decade is the year minus its remainder by 10.

label_corrections.why: the decade needs arithmetic on the launch year (2006 -> the 2000s), which DL cannot express
